ValidationRule.description: SOW Number is required for DMS cases when Contract Status is 'Accepted' or 'Accepted with Follow up'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $RecordType.Name = 'NCSP: DMS' && ( ispickval( Contract_Status__c ,'Accepted') || ispickval( Contract_Status__c ,'Accepted with Follow up')) && ISBLANK(SOW_Number__c)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: SOW Number is required for DMS cases when Contract Status is 'Accepted' or 'Accepted with Follow up'
